account_appeal.text: Business: Example Strength Studio LLC, three strength gyms in Dallas, Texas. Website https://examplestrength.example, Facebook Page Example Strength Studio. Ad account act_100000000000002 was used for our online coaching program. It was restricted on October 7, 2026 for not following the Advertising Standards. The cause was ours: in August and September we ran before-and-after body images and weight-loss promises with a set timeframe, and several were rejected. By October 28, 2026 we had removed every ad of that kind, rewritten the program's ads to describe the coaching, price and schedule instead of body outcomes, and now check each new ad against the Health and Wellness and Privacy Violations and Personal Attributes policies before it is published. We ask you to review the restriction on this ad account.
